subject.title: [Bug]: Mattermost interaction token forgeable via hardcoded HMAC derivation key

question: What durable Mattermost interaction signing model should replace the current bot-token-derived HMAC secret?
rationale: The source-reproduced weakness is real, but the fix changes a channel authorization boundary and can affect existing callbacks, restarts, split processes, docs, and credential setup.

options.title: Provision A Durable Secret
options.body: Require a configured or persisted per-account interaction secret through supported SecretRef/setup/docs paths before landing the fix.

options.title: Accept Explicit Fail-Closed Setup
options.body: Require operators to configure an interaction secret and make missing-secret failures explicit in code, docs, and tests.

options.title: Pause For Security Advisory Handling
options.body: Move remaining coordination through maintainer security review before choosing public PR handling or a replacement patch.

recommendation.title: Provision A Durable Secret
recommendation.body: Require a configured or persisted per-account interaction secret through supported SecretRef/setup/docs paths before landing the fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently hardened the same Mattermost interaction callback authorization path and are a strong routing candidate for the boundary decision.
